name: GA Cubers Warm Up 2022
information:
This competition is a special competition with side events; we will not hold 3x3x3. For a more normal competition experience, we recommend checking out [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2022).

This competition is the same day as [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2022), which is a multi-location FMC Championship. We recommend checking it out and registering for it as well if you are interested.
